title: Hanasato Minori — Soothed By Friendship〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Airi and Shizuku are probably on their way to the meeting for that radio program right about now...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...? Hang on...
There's stuff here for weekday afternoons now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's just you and Shizuku, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I do agree that we should accept whatever offers we can, even if all four of us can't be there...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, a lot of people out there want to see us together. As such, I'd like to be careful about which offers we do accept.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. This is just a preliminary idea. Just one solution for addressing how we may or may not accept more offers moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(The credit-based course...
It definitely seems to come in handy in these sorts of situations...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I need to focus on what I can do for us right now!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Let's see... I'll start by thinking of ideas for our next stream.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The others keep saying how I'm really good at seeing things from the fans' perspective, so I'll try coming up with another idea from that angle!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
If I were a MORE MORE JUMP! fan...
I'd want to learn more about what Haruka and the others are like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In particular, what they do on a day-to-day basis as opposed to what they do as idols... Oh, like when they're at school!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A stream about them as students...
Hmm... Maybe they could tell everyone what they talk about with friends?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Or talk about their uniforms and bags...
Wait, our bags!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I bet their fans would love to see what they carry around and what kinds of pens and stuff they use!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It'd be nice to find out that you use the same things, and you might be able to go get matching stuff after the stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, that's one idea on paper!
I'll think about the details with Haruka and the others later!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I gotta keep coming up with ideas while I still have some momentum!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka's probably also trying to come up with ideas right now in her classroom...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hehe. I really wanna surprise her by thinking of a bunch! Then, she'll...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You came up with all these ideas for us?!
Thank you so much! I knew I could count on you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I think you deserve a little reward for all your hard work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, Minori...
Come here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ready?
A nice pat on the back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: E-Eeeeeeeeeeeep!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Hehehehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That's it...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Imagine how happy everyone would be if their favorite idols praised them like that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We could ask them about what they've been working on lately... Oh, and who they want to be praised by!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You look like you're having fun, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh! Hi, Kohane!
I was just coming up with some ideas for our stream.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I had a feeling.
I could hear you mumbling to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! Haha...
I guess I got a little carried away while thinking.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually, I'm putting together this idea for a stream where viewers could get praised for something they've been working on!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Praised by you and the others?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, I was also thinking that we could do a “What's In Our Bags?!” segment!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, Kohane! Can you tell me what you think about my ideas? I want your honest opinion.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I've been trying to come up with ideas that our fans would really enjoy and appreciate, but I'm sure we're gonna have some first-time viewers too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi also told me that we shouldn't think of everything from the fans' perspective.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, if you think my opinion will help...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Thank you so much, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, this is my first idea...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Was that the warning bell...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, our break's already over...
How do you feel about your ideas?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great! Thanks for telling me what you think! I really appreciate it, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm gonna return to my seat.
Good luck with your brainstorming!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, thanks again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh oh... I forgot to eat lunch.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hmm... But my ideas are coming along so nicely...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Airi and Shizuku are also doing their best right now...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...! So, I'll polish up these ideas now and sneak in a meal later between classes or something!
